mutations.name: a gate that cannot be read reads as skipped, which clears the base guard
mutations.find: if ("unreadable" in gate) return { kind: "error", reason: gate.unreadable };
mutations.replace: if ("unreadable" in gate) return { kind: "skipped", reason: gate.unreadable };
